messages:
Priya Shah: Heads-up: support escalated a fintech customer experiencing widespread 5xx and timeouts from hosted inference. Started ~11:12 UTC, majority from us-east-1. They sent sample request IDs in the ticket.

Alice Nguyen: @channel I'm oncall. Can support paste customer request IDs + region headers? Also, any recent deploys or infra changes?

Priya Shah: Ticket INC-2026-431 includes req ids req_f234a1.. and req_f234a7.. Customer says failures coincide with their scheduled batch window.

Mateo Ortiz: Observing spike on telemetry: token p50 and p95 jump, 5xx rate climbs sharply at 11:11:30. Quick diagnostic snippets below:
```
EDGE-GW: upstream read timeout -> model-pool (10s)
MODEL-POOL: grpc: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED", connection reset
KUBE: pod inference-worker-3 terminated OOMKilled @11:12:05
```

Daniel Kim: OOM kills + RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED from model pool looks suspect. Any canary activity? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Deploy started: inference-service v2.14.3 canary, initiated 10:58 UTC, 50% canary, completed rollout 11:09 UTC.

Alice Nguyen: Canary finished right before spike. Mateo, pull worker logs and tokenizer memory stats. Daniel, check node-level OOMs and kube eviction events.

Mateo Ortiz: From worker logs:
```
2026-03-15T11:10:51Z tokenizer: cache_entries=1.45M rss=13.7GB
2026-03-15T11:11:08Z cache: eviction failure, slab full
2026-03-15T11:11:22Z request loop: unhandled exception -> close connection
```
Also lots of gRPC "RST_STREAM" with resource exhausted.

Daniel Kim: Node metrics: two nodes in us-east-1a had transient memory pressure + evictions at 11:12. HPA didn't scale because we only had cpu-based scaler; no mem trigger configured.

Alice Nguyen: Immediate plan: 1) pause the rollout, 2) scale up worker replicas, 3) route impacted customers to a stable model variant (v2.13), 4) increase edge proxy read timeout to reduce 502/504 noise while stabilizing.

Alice Nguyen: Pausing rollout now.

deploy-bot: Action: rollout paused for inference-service v2.14.3 @11:21 UTC.

Daniel Kim: Scaling deployment: kubectl scale deploy/inference-workers --replicas=30 -n prod-us-east (adding capacity). Cordoning the two affected nodes for investigation.

Mateo Ortiz: Applied customer routing for fintech-prod: redwood route set --customer fintech-prod --model v2.13 --force. Customer reports immediate improvement.

Priya Shah: Let customer know we've routed them to fallback and are investigating root cause. They're currently back online.

Alice Nguyen: Increased gateway proxy_read_timeout to 20s and reloaded the edge. Ops confirmed reload at 11:24.

Daniel Kim: Post mitigation metrics: 5xx rate back down from ~20% to ~2% within ~6 minutes. Tail latency still elevated for some flows but overall stable.

Priya Shah: Customer confirmed recovered. They've requested a postmortem and assurances about recurrence.

Alice Nguyen: Preliminary suspected root cause: v2.14.3 introduced a tokenizer cache growth/regression under high-concurrency batch workloads which caused high RSS, OOMs, and upstream gRPC RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors. Contributing factor: autoscaler lacked memory-based trigger and node eviction thresholds were permissive during bursts.

Mateo Ortiz: Repro steps I ran locally using customer's batch load (provided by support):
1) Run concurrent replay (200 streams) with long prefixes
2) Watch tokenizer cache entries + worker rss grow
3) Observe KV cache eviction errors and gRPC resource exhausted + RST_STREAM

Local repro command used:
```
wrk -t12 -c200 -d90s --script=fintech_batch.lua https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate
```

Daniel Kim: Infra immediate actions (completed): scaled replicas, paused rollout, bumped gateway timeout, cordoned nodes. Follow-ups:
- A1: Add node eviction guardrails for rolling updates and bursts (owner: Daniel) - due EOD
- A2: Add HPA based on memory RSS + pod metrics (owner: Daniel) - priority P1, due in 3 days

Mateo Ortiz / Eng-ML actions:
- B1: Rollback v2.14.3 from prod canary and re-run canary with synthetic high-concurrency batch tests (owner: Mateo) - rollback scheduled
- B2: Fix tokenizer cache leak, add hard cap on cache size, and improve crash-safe behavior (owner: Mateo + Eng-ML) - target 7 days
- B3: CI regression test simulating batch bursts, include in pre-rollout checks (owner: Eng-Platform) - 14 days

Support actions:
- C1: Customer comms with timeline + interim mitigation details (owner: Priya) - today
- C2: KB article on fallback routing + what to expect when we route to older model (owner: Priya) - 5 days

Observability/Alerts:
- D1: New alert: 5xx rate > 5% for 2m -> page SRE (owner: Alice) - today
- D2: Alert on tokenizer_cache_entries growth rate > threshold -> warn (owner: Eng-ML) - 3 days
- D3: Dashboard correlating KV cache miss rate, gRPC errors, and pod RSS (owner: Eng-Platform) - 4 days

Mateo Ortiz: I opened a quick PR that adds a short-term limiter to tokenizer cache entries (protective cap) to prevent runaway growth; will coordinate with Eng-ML for a proper fix.

Daniel Kim: I'll uncordon nodes once memory pressure clears and we've validated stability. Notifying infra rotation.

Alice Nguyen: Postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. Invite includes Eng, Eng-ML, SRE, Support, Product. Bring heap samples, canary config, and traffic traces.

Priya Shah: Notified customer and CC'd legal for regulated-data note. Will update INC-2026-431 with timeline and link to postmortem doc.

Mateo Ortiz: Suggest adding a circuit-breaker fallback when KV cache miss rate > X to return degraded/fast-fail responses instead of cascading failures. Adding to the B2 scope.

Alice Nguyen: Summary: Canaryed deploy triggered tokenizer cache runaway in a specific batch workload -> pod OOMs -> model gRPC failures -> edge timeouts/5xx. Mitigations: paused rollout, scaled replicas, routed customers to fallback, increased proxy timeout. Next: revert + patch + autoscaling + alerts + regression tests. Owners assigned above.

Priya Shah: Closing war room. I'll post incident notes to the ticket and link the postmortem when done. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-431 | Hosted inference - tokenizer cache regression -> 5xx/timeouts | Severity: Sev2 -> upgraded to Sev1 (customer impact) | Thread 1832607777

Alice Nguyen: Thanks all. If you have logs/heap dumps please upload to the ticket. We'll review in postmortem.
